notes: Sweep themes: admin already covered (UC07/UC08); added support, a notification that needs a decision, forgotten password, audit log and error handling.

value.name: Reset Password
value.description: The founder requests a password reset link and sets a new password to regain access.

value.name: Respond to Failed Credit Purchase
value.description: When the payment gateway reports a failed credit purchase, the founder decides whether to retry the payment or choose another package.

ops.reason: S-3.3 sweep: notifications — the recipient must decide, so this is a use case, not a passive receive

value.name: View Audit Log
value.description: The admin reviews the log of destructive or high-trust actions such as waived flags and manual reverts.

value.name: Recover From Validation Error
value.description: The founder is shown the specific validation error when a step's draft is rejected and chooses to retry or provide more detail.

value.name: Contact Support
value.description: The founder reaches a support channel when the guided pipeline cannot resolve a problem on its own.
